title: 복습 C: 받침, 어떻게 읽어요?
objective: You can read a word with a final consonant, for example 옷 [옫] and 앞 [압].
summary: Many final consonants (batchim) share just seven sounds.

task.title: Read and sort batchim
task.line: Say each word out loud, then write or choose the final sound.

letters.as: Like k in 'book', but stop without a puff of air.

letters.letter: ㄷ, ㅅ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ, ㅎ
letters.as: Like t in 'hot', tongue stops; no puff of air.
Like p in 'cup', lips close and stay closed.

exercises: Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 맛 ② 숲 ③ 히읗
Do the two words sound the same? Write Same or Different: ① 입 – 잎 ② 빗 – 빛 ③ 강 – 감
Which final sound do you hear: [ㄱ], [ㄷ], or [ㅂ]? ① 무릎 ② 몇 ③ 키읔
Does the batchim sound change from how it is written? Write Yes or No: ① 산 ② 밑 ③ 곰
answers: ① Same [입] ② Same [빋] ③ Different
① No ② Yes [믿] ③ No
